title: senna hebecarpa
intro: Senna hebecarpa, commonly known as Gray's senna or Canadian senna, is a perennial flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae) native to eastern North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to stimulate bowel movements and relieve constipation due to its anthraquinone glycosides content, which acts as a natural laxative. The health benefits of Senna hebecarpa include the potential treatment of various gastrointestinal issues, such as irritable bowel syndrome, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Senna hebecarpa include anthraquinone glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anthelmintic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
